text:
Maya (Growth Marketing): Heads up 5 Vireo Labs signed off on a case story. They can do 30m next Wed morning or Fri afternoon. Need to coordinate interview Qs, quote capture, legal consent, asset permissions, and routing leads from the follow-up webinar.
Sam (Content): Nice. I'll draft a focused Q list (problem, approach, results, quote). Can we aim to get the interview recorded and get a short 60s highlight clip?
Leila (Comms): Yes. I'll collect two quote variants during recording and request logo+brand usage. Who's owning the 1-pager and social cut?
Maya (Growth Marketing): Leila takes comms assets, Sam builds the long form case doc. Nina will handle webinar follow-up. Phil, what do you need from us for legal signoff?
Phil (Legal): Please get a signed case-study release (use our template), final approved quote text in email, and confirm logo format (eps/png/svg). If they provide metrics, mark as "customer-reported" unless audited. I'll prioritize review once quote text is in thread.
Sam (Content): Uploading draft Qs to drive: https://drive.redwood/vireo/case-qs.md. Includes a metrics prompt for latency and cost impact.
Leila (Comms): Also need product screenshots and a sanitized arch diagram. Maya, can Eng provide a public-safe diagram?
Maya (Growth Marketing): Eng - can you export a redacted diagram? @DeployBot pull the public-safe artifact.
DeployBot: Found public-safe diagram: https://assets.redwood/arch/public/serve-diag-v3.png
Nina (Webinars): I'll plan a 15m customer spotlight webinar two weeks after publish. Let's decide whether to invite Vireo as a guest speaker or record a pre-taped segment. Live will convert better for leads.
Jordan (Sales Ops): For lead routing, we'll tag inbound as "case_vireo" and route to the AE queue plus notify the account owner. Need publish date and gating rules.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Tentative timeline: interview next Fri, draft next Mon, legal review Tue, publish Thurs the following week. Jordan, can you set up the tag and mapping by publish day?
Jordan (Sales Ops): Yep. I'll configure the tag and the automated routing. Please give me the final publish URL and campaign ID.
Phil (Legal): Reminder: if they ask to edit quotes after the interview, we need written approval of the redline. Keep the original recording and notes.
Leila (Comms): I'll capture both quote variants live and email them with a short approval thread. Also starting the layout for the one-pager in /marketing/case-studies/vireo/.
Sam (Content): Action items: confirm interview time, get signed consent before publish, collect metrics and mark as customer-reported, lock assets (logo + diagram), final quote email for Phil. I'll include a consent blurb at the start of the interview.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Great. I'll confirm time with Vireo now and send calendar invite with the consent doc attached: https://redwood.company/legal/templates/case-study-consent-v1.docx. Closing this thread 5 update the folder as you complete items. :memo:
